Main Lemma4.13 pp.36–37 reverses plans so absolutely continuous terminal density is the source; other endpoint may be singular; mixtures stay calibrated. RCD* input follows from the unreduced assumption without changing K,N.

Main p.8 and §§5.1–5.2: exact H^n and full support give a.e. Euclidean n-tangents/module rank and noncollapsed upper density; lower local ball bounds are separately obtained from Bishop–Gromov/full support.
Main Proposition5.1 proof p.40 applies product theorem with auxiliary N=n+1, k=n, point residual RCD(0,1), radius 2Ar_k/5, giving output ball B(y,2Ar_k). Actual measure/dimension remains H^n,n.

Main Proposition5.6 pp.42–44 uses bounded-support optimal test plans, H2,2 compact test potentials, bounded weighted restrictions and affine time reparametrization. The conclusion is a.e. pathwise identity obtained through L2(plan)/Fubini, not an identity for every geodesic.
Main Theorem3.1 p.9; unreduced RCD((n−1)κ,n), exact Hausdorff measure, no boundaryless/compactness hypothesis.
Main Lemma5.5 p.42 applies same-rescaling tangent continuity along every geodesic to nearby regular times, then lets those times converge. Endpoints rely on bounded compression.
